node.toolmastery.masons_grip.desc: Passive: mine stone, deepslate and ores faster with a pickaxe. I: +10%. II: +20%. III: +30%.
node.toolmastery.miners_magnet.desc: Passive: drops from blocks broken with a pickaxe go straight into your inventory — including the extras from Dig Range and Rich Vein, and what Melt already smelted. Whatever does not fit is left on the ground.
node.toolmastery.melt.desc: Enchantment: chance to smelt ore drops on the spot. I: 25%. II: 50%. III: 100%. Applied to your held pickaxe on purchase; also available via /enchant.
node.toolmastery.dig_range.desc: Enchantment: break extra blocks. I: the block below. II: a cross on the facing plane. III: full 3x3. Sneak to disable. Applied to your held pickaxe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.prospectors_sense.desc: Active: nearby ores glow through stone for a few seconds.
node.toolmastery.miners_helm.desc: Unlocks the recipe for a helmet that grants night vision deep underground.
node.toolmastery.rich_vein.desc: Enchantment: vein miner — breaking an ore breaks connected ores of the same type. I: up to 8. II: up to 16. Sneak to disable. Applied to your held pickaxe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.deep_haste.desc: Passive: permanent Haste I while you are below Y = 0. Never overrides a stronger Haste from a beacon or a potion.
node.toolmastery.obsidian_breaker.desc: Passive: obsidian and crying obsidian break 50% faster with a pickaxe.
node.toolmastery.magma_touch.desc: Capstone enchantment: everything you mine drops pre-smelted — ingots, glass, stone, bricks. Exclusive with Ancient Fortune.
node.toolmastery.ancient_fortune.desc: Capstone: +1 effective Fortune level on your pickaxe. Exclusive with Magma Touch.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms.desc: Passive: chop wood faster with an axe. I: +15%. II: +30%. III: +45%.
node.toolmastery.loggers_magnet.desc: Passive: blocks chopped with an axe drop straight into your inventory, Logic fells included. Anything that does not fit stays on the ground.
node.toolmastery.fair_harvest.desc: Passive: +25% sapling drop chance from every leaf block you break, on top of the vanilla roll.
node.toolmastery.logic.desc: Enchantment: breaking one log fells the whole tree (needs leaves — houses are safe). I: slow cascade. II: instant. III: clears the leaves too. Sneak to disable. Applied to your held axe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.rich_bark.desc: Stripping logs drops Bark — a light fuel and compostable item.
node.toolmastery.pruner.desc: Passive: leaves broken with an axe drop double loot — apples, saplings and sticks alike.
node.toolmastery.double_axe.desc: Passive: chance for a chopped log to drop twice. I: 10%. II: 20%. Every log of a Logic fell rolls on its own.
node.toolmastery.shield_breaker.desc: Passive: your axes disable a blocking shield for 2 extra seconds and push 2 more damage through it.
node.toolmastery.call_of_the_forest.desc: Active: bone-meal effect in a 5x5 area.
node.toolmastery.environment.desc: Enchantment: trees felled with Logic III replant their sapling on the stump, consuming one from your inventory. Applied to your held axe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_fury.desc: Capstone: for 10s, Logic reaches every tree around you and chops twice as fast. Exclusive with Green Heart.
node.toolmastery.green_heart.desc: Capstone: replanted saplings may grow instantly; Pruner gains Fortune. Exclusive with Lumberjack's Fury.
node.toolmastery.arcane_insight.desc: Passive: read the true enchantments behind the enchanting table's offers before paying. I: reads the first slot. II: the first two. III: all three. Shown in a panel beside the table screen.
node.toolmastery.scholar.desc: Passive: gain bonus XP from every source — orbs, smelting, breeding, bottles. I: +20%. II: +40%. III: +60%.
node.toolmastery.book_binder.desc: Crafting books and bookshelves has a 50% chance to refund one ingredient.
node.toolmastery.tome_keeper.desc: Unlocks the recipe for the Arcane Tome — a portable library that stores your enchanted books.
node.toolmastery.inner_focus.desc: Passive: enchanting no longer requires or consumes lapis lazuli — your focus channels the table directly.
node.toolmastery.anvil_adept.desc: Anvil repairs and merges cost 30% fewer levels and never become 'Too Expensive'.
node.toolmastery.arcane_conduit.desc: Your enchanting table reaches full power with half the bookshelves.
node.toolmastery.curse_breaker.desc: Active: the grindstone can strip curses from your gear.
node.toolmastery.rewrite_fate.desc: Capstone: adds a Reroll button to the enchanting table — reroll its offers as many times as you like, completely free. Exclusive with Ancient Knowledge.
node.toolmastery.ancient_knowledge.desc: Capstone: table offers can roll one level above their vanilla cap. Exclusive with Rewrite Fate.
